name: yf_major_holders
description:
Ownership breakdown for one stock from Yahoo Finance (yfinance major_holders).
Returns: {symbol, holders: [{index, Value}]} where index is insidersPercentHeld, institutionsPercentHeld, institutionsFloatPercentHeld or institutionsCount and percentages are fractions (0.62 = 62%).
Inputs (* required): symbol* (Yahoo ticker, e.g. AAPL, BRK-B, 7203.T).
Named holders: yf_institutional_holders, yf_mutual_fund_holders. No API key; data comes from Yahoo Finance through the yfinance library.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL"}
